gen-comfortaa-gf-rhodium-libre: Rhodium Libre brings an editorial, traditional serif voice, with brush-like ends that lift away before each curve closes. And Comfortaa glides above it like bent wire, so a long run of text feels bookish beneath a friendly, rounded headline.
gen-comfortaa-gf-rokkitt: Comfortaa draws its geometric, friendly letters with a plain, unmodulated outline. Rokkitt, a bookish serif with a c as open as a bent paperclip, gives that ring-shaped display type something traditional to rest on below.
gen-comfortaa-gf-sanchez: Sanchez is a bookish, dignified serif, and its c opens like a pair of calipers. Sanchez keeps a long stretch of text feeling formal and settled, while Comfortaa above it never shows a single thin hairline.
gen-comfortaa-gf-solway: Comfortaa stretches its spacing like an uncoiled spring, and every stroke looks drawn in neon tube. But Solway, a classic serif with sign-painter flatness and generous e eyes, brings the authority.
gen-comfortaa-gf-yuji-boku: Dignified and editorial, this pairing sets a friendly Comfortaa ring of a c over a classic serif. Yuji Boku holds each stroke at one thickness like a drawn cable, which is the quality that ties them together.
gen-comfortaa-nunito-sans: Comfortaa leads with uninterrupted monoline strokes and a c shaped like a wide-open ring, geometric and friendly. And Nunito Sans follows with soft, open-mouthed small letters, so the display heading and the sans text feel like relatives.
gen-dafont-aaargh-fs-bespoke-slab: Aaargh is strong and commanding, with bowls and stems drawn at one weight and a generous entry into the e's eye. Bespoke Slab answers underneath with tall, grounded lowercase.
gen-dafont-aaargh-newsreader: Aaargh holds every line at the same thickness, giving headings a strong, commanding presence with generous e eyes. Newsreader does the quieter work, a text serif whose faint stem-to-connector pull and open jaws keep paragraphs refined.
gen-dafont-aaargh-source-serif-4: Source Serif 4 is a dignified text serif with a gaping c and a slight tightening at curve tops. Source Serif 4 has hairlines that are present but not razor thin, so paragraphs feel firm under Aaargh's zero-contrast heading.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-fs-rowan: Alien Encounters spaces its letter pairs with big, open gaps and a high x-height, an otherworldly, technological look. Rowan, a friendly classic serif with generous curve openings, reads with a literary warmth across a longer page.
